forecasts.reason: E033 scaling gives about -0.11 s. Accuracy cost is under 0.1 pp but re-rolled seeds put it right at the gate.
12 cheap 20 px steps save about 0.14 s. Stretching the LR and Lookahead schedules shifts the end-of-run dynamics, which have been fragile, and the 0.1 pp loss bound is below 10-seed resolution.
Freezing conv1 before the 28→32 switch hits the same adaptation problem as E037, and saves only part of E037's 0.25 s.
My mechanism: freezing at the start of the 32 px phase leaves no adaptation window, so it loses about 0.2 pp for about 0.08 s.
Lookahead's final copy already holds averaged BN buffers. A recompute gives at most about +0.1 pp, too small to detect at the +0.15 pp keep gate, and costs about 0.05 s.
16 px gives 1×1 final maps, a regime change. That is not as free as 20 px was, and the saving is sublinear.
Removes only about 0.02 s from the mean, below H3.2's 0.05 s target. Bit-identity may break, as it did in E035.

cruxes: Is E037's freeze cliff caused by losing group 1's adaptation window across the 28→32 px switch (so I063 at 70% fails), or by a smooth dose effect (so I063 costs only about 0.1 pp)?

With the population mean at about 0.7525, is there any lever whose time saved per pp of accuracy lost beats paying back an epoch top-up at about 1.5 s/pp? Or is the honest next move a +0.25 epoch top-up?
Do stem-truncation savings, which are bandwidth-bound, carry over to the PCIe judge's lower clocks? This decides whether freeze-type levers or resolution levers should get the priority.
structured_output.world_model: W5, after E038. Population mean about 0.7525, under the gate. Early low resolution is nearly free down to 20 px; 16 px (1×1 maps) is a regime change. The freeze cliff comes from group 1 needing unfrozen steps after the 28→32 switch, so I063 and I062 should lose about 0.2 pp. End-of-run dynamics are locally optimal, so BN recompute and Lookahead tweaks gain at most about 0.1 pp. Fixed costs are exhausted (about 0.02 s left). Next real move: take the cheap 20 px time savings (I060/I061) plus an epoch top-up to restore 0.1–0.2 pp of headroom.
